name: HORSE
description: A large four-legged animal used for riding and carrying loads

name: WOLF
description: A wild predator that hunts in a group; symbol of fierce loyalty

name: LION
description: A great wild cat; symbol of strength and noble authority

name: EAGLE
description: A large bird of prey with keen sight that soars at great height

name: SNAKE
description: A legless creature that moves by sliding; symbol of hidden danger and change

name: BEAR
description: A large strong animal that endures harsh seasons; symbol of protective power

name: DEER
description: A gentle swift animal of the forest; symbol of grace and awareness

name: IRON
description: A hard strong metal used to build and shape; the most common working material

name: GLASS
description: A hard clear material that allows light to pass through; fragile and transparent

name: GOLD
description: A precious yellow metal of lasting value; symbol of wealth and perfection

name: CLOTH
description: Woven material made from thread; used to cover and protect the body

name: PAPER
description: A thin flat material for writing and recording thought; carries knowledge forward

name: MEAT
description: The flesh of an animal eaten as food; source of strength and nourishment

name: GRAIN
description: The seed of a cereal plant harvested for food; the smallest unit of a crop

name: SALT
description: A white mineral that preserves and gives taste; essential for life

name: CHILD
description: A young person in the early stage of growth; one who is learning and becoming

name: SOLDIER
description: One who fights under authority and follows command; a person of discipline

name: JUDGE
description: One who decides what is right according to law and principle; an authority of justice

name: SERVANT
description: One who works in the service of another; a person who gives effort to a greater purpose

name: YEAR
description: One full cycle of the earth around the sun; a complete measure of seasonal time
